arms.posthoc_statement: The round-1 and round-2 papers of this plan (sets nature_r1, nature_r2) already have advance codings under the full run (tag full-advance), made before this plan was drafted; their verdicts are on disk and entered the advance test of preregistration/advance-plan.json in aggregate. Their review codings, from which the review-derived features (outside_only_loops, tried_dropped, review_loops, review_V_loops, claim_narrowed, disclosures, disclosures_dropped) are computed, do not exist at freeze (freeze refuses otherwise). paper_returns, paper_revisits and paper_steps come from the inquiry codings (calc1, r2), which exist for these papers, and the advance test related them to outcomes in aggregate (advance-plan.json H9, any return after failure against score). The plan is therefore blind to the association of the review-derived features with outcome for these papers, not to their outcomes and not to H8 (paper_returns) or the three covariates. They form a post-hoc arm: reported apart from the prospective arm (nature22) and added to the pooled sensitivity only as the labelled variants P1b and P2, which leave out H8, as do the post-hoc and both-arms estimates; the covariates stay in every model and are labelled not blind. The drafting agent listed which advance files exist for these keys and did not read any verdict.

features: Features (per paper; g34.features_of on g31_reconstruct.paper() with REVIEW_TAG as the disclosure source and the kept disclosures of check_coding_nature.kept_disclosures; the definitions of the reconstruction plan): outside_only_loops, tried_dropped, review_loops, review_V_loops, claim_narrowed, paper_returns, paper_revisits, paper_steps, disclosures, disclosures_dropped, and g34's decomposition and sensitivity features. revision_share is None (no layer 4). The author document of the same-event rule is every A unit of the paper (unit locator up to the first '-'). g31's disclosure match to review steps reads Copernicus document names only, so on these papers no disclosure matches a review step; no feature used here depends on that match. response_words: words of the A units.
outcomes: as preregistration/reconstruction.json (g34.outcomes); cnp and fwci from the set metrics.json

analysis.descriptive: Descriptive, no confirmatory claim, no p-value, no verdict, for the prospective arm, the post-hoc arm and both: per feature n, mean, median, quartiles, papers with at least one (g31.dist); verdict distribution; for each hypothesis of the reconstruction family but H7, the partial Spearman within journal strata with its 95% bootstrap interval (NBOOT, g20.gen 'nature|<arm>|<id>'), reported as an estimate only; feature distributions by journal. H8 (paper_returns) is left out of the post-hoc and both-arms estimates (NOT_BLIND_POSTHOC).
analysis.pooled_sensitivity: Pooled sensitivity of the reconstruction hypotheses: the complete Copernicus papers of the frozen g34 test (its own sets, tags, checks and cut-off, read through g34; not run when g34's checks refuse) with the complete Nature-family papers; H1-H6 and H8 (H7 needs layer 4); g34's test rule (partial Spearman, Freedman-Lane permutation within strata, bootstrap, BH q < Q over this family). P1 strata journal (a journal is its own stratum, journals under MIN_STRATUM pooled), prospective arm only; P1b as P1 with the post-hoc arm added (labelled post-hoc); P2 strata journal x set, both arms. P1b and P2 leave out H8 (NOT_BLIND_POSTHOC): its feature, paper_returns, comes from the inquiry coding, which exists for the post-hoc papers and entered the advance test (H9) before this plan. Reported beside the frozen reconstruction answer; it does not change that answer. The H1-H2 answer rule of g34 is applied to P1 and labelled 'pooled sensitivity'.
analysis.confirmatory: none: these papers alone support no confirmatory claim

hypotheses_pooled.theory: selection under test: a claim that survived alternatives tried and dropped, and tests run only for review, is more often warranted as reported; rival (requests follow weak papers) predicts a negative sign
as H1, on the size of the warranted gain
alternatives tried before the reported route (any final status): the reported route is the survivor
referees ask for checks of the principal threat; the checks added enter the paper the blind coder reads
work reopened at review adds warrant to the published text (uncertainty, checks, consistency)
a claim narrowed at review fits its warrant in the published text; rival (narrowing is asked of overreaching papers and stays partial) predicts a positive sign
loops the paper reports are selected for the argument; the claim that H8 is weaker than H1 is tested separately (one-sided bootstrap of H1 minus H8, CONTRAST_ALPHA)

not_blind_posthoc.rule: left out of P1b, P2 and the post-hoc and both-arms estimates; the covariates stay in every model, labelled not blind for the post-hoc arm
